name: Divide and Conquer Expansion Inventory
description: Declarative refinement inventory for divide-and-conquer pipelines.

operations.name: Insert Split Balance Analysis
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether recursive splits are becoming badly unbalanced.

rewrite.after_summary: A split-balance analysis stage is inserted after partitioning.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds partition-quality evidence before recursive descent.

operations.name: Insert Recursion Depth Check
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether recursion is getting too deep for the input size.

rewrite.before_summary: Recursive calls proceed without depth-vs-size evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: A recursion-depth check is inserted before recursive descent.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds stack-depth and termination-risk evidence before recursing.

operations.name: Insert Merge Cost Profiling
operations.dejargonized_summary: Measure whether merge work is dominating the algorithm.

rewrite.before_summary: Merge output feeds downstream stages without cost attribution.
rewrite.after_summary: A merge-cost profiler is inserted after merge.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds runtime composition evidence for divide-and-conquer overhead.

operations.name: Insert Subproblem Overlap Detection
operations.dejargonized_summary: Detect repeated subproblems that may call for memoization or dynamic programming.

rewrite.before_summary: Subproblems are split without checking repeated work.
rewrite.after_summary: An overlap detector is inserted before splitting.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds repeated-subproblem evidence that can justify memoization or DP refinement.

audit.rationale: Moves existing divide-and-conquer expansion rules onto the common provider expansion schema.
audit.dejargonized_summary: Reusable checks for recursive split quality, recursion depth, merge cost, and repeated subproblems.
